description: This file implements the Response class for handling JSON-RPC responses over WebSockets, including methods for retrieving IDs, checking for result or error presence, extracting result/error data, and validating the response structure.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response data and validate message integrity.

methods.name: Response::Response
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Response object, inheriting from WPEFramework::Core::JSONRPC::Message.

methods.name: Response::getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response.

methods.name: Response::isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: Response::getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object if present.

methods.name: Response::isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: Response::getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object if present.

methods.name: Response::isValid
methods.description: Validates the response message structure and content.
